description: This file contains unit tests for the make_dafsa module, testing functions related to parsing gperf input, creating DAFSA structures, reversing, joining labels and suffixes, topological sorting, encoding prefixes, labels, links, and converting words to C++ format. It also includes tests for specific example inputs and outputs.

classes.name: ParseGperfTest
classes.description: Unit tests for parsing gperf input and handling errors.

classes.name: ToDafsaTest
classes.description: Unit tests for creating DAFSA from words and handling invalid input.

classes.name: ToWordsTest
classes.description: Unit tests for converting DAFSA nodes to word lists.

classes.name: JoinLabelsTest
classes.description: Unit tests for joining label sequences in DAFSA nodes.

classes.name: JoinSuffixesTest
classes.description: Unit tests for joining suffixes in DAFSA nodes.

classes.name: ReverseTest
classes.description: Unit tests for reversing DAFSA structures.

classes.name: TopSortTest
classes.description: Unit tests for topological sorting of DAFSA nodes.

classes.name: EncodePrefixTest
classes.description: Unit tests for encoding prefix labels.

classes.name: EncodeLabelTest
classes.description: Unit tests for encoding label strings.

classes.name: EncodeLinksTest
classes.description: Unit tests for encoding link offsets.

classes.name: ExamplesTest
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying example inputs and outputs for make_dafsa functions.
